The unproved claim after the definition, that these sums make every sigma-effect algebra a sigma-PAM extending its PCM, is canonicalSigmaPAM / canonicalSigmaPAM_extends: partition-associativity rests on isSupOf_ovee_chain (⊕ preserves suprema of increasing sequences), proved here.

The printed ingredients are all used - the differences b_n, the partition of the index set to show the sum is an upper bound, and the c^perp trick with the limit axiom for leastness - but ours proves the coincidence of sums first, for every countable family at once (no reduction to J = N), and then derives omega-completeness from it via the differences.
